Thief.description: Hones skills in thievery, acrobatics, and stealth to infiltrate secure locations and outmaneuver foes.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.tldr: Use Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or use an object as a bonus action.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.tldr: Gain a climbing speed and improve your running jump distances.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.tldr: Gain advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on the turn.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.tldr: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.tldr: Take two turns during the first round of any combat, one at your normal initiative and one at initiative minus 10.

Assassin.description: Focuses on the grim arts of infiltration and sudden, lethal execution from the shadows.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with disguise kits and poisoner's kits.

3.name: Assassinate
3.tldr: Gain advantage against creatures who haven't taken a turn yet, and score automatic critical hits against surprised foes.

9.name: Infiltration Expertise
9.tldr: Craft false identities complete with documentation and history with ease.

13.name: Imposter
13.tldr: Mimic someone else's speech, writing, and behavior flawlessly to deceive others.

17.name: Death Strike
17.tldr: Attack a surprised target to force a Constitution save, doubling your attack and sneak attack damage on a failure.

Arcane Trickster.description: Combines a rogue's stealth and agility with the utility and deception of wizard spells.

3.name: Spellcasting
3.tldr: Cast wizard spells (primarily illusion and enchantment) using Intelligence.

3.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
3.tldr: Control an invisible Mage Hand to pick locks, disarm traps, and steal items stealthily.

9.name: Magical Ambush
9.tldr: Enemies have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells if you cast them while hidden.

13.name: Versatile Trickster
13.tldr: Use your Mage Hand to distract targets, granting you advantage on attack rolls against them.

17.name: Spell Thief
17.tldr: Steal the knowledge of a spell when a creature casts it against you, preventing its use and letting you cast it instead.
